name: Percent Live Births by Infant Sex and Mother’s Race/Ethnicity
description:
This dataset reports live births by infant sex and the mother’s race/ethnicity for each year from 2007 to 2023. Each row gives a birth year, whether the infant was male or female, the mother’s race/ethnicity group (including Non-Hispanic White, Non-Hispanic Black, Hispanic, Asian/Pacific Islander, and Other), the number of births in that group, and the percentage that count represents. The sample covers 184 rows across 17 years and seven race/ethnicity categories.

The data can be used to compare birth counts and sex proportions across racial and ethnic groups over time, to track year-to-year trends, and to examine whether the share of male versus female births differs by group or period. It is useful for demographic analysis, public health reporting, and exploratory charts or dashboards on birth patterns. Because counts vary widely between groups, users should consider both the number of births and the percentage when making comparisons.
